info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Baggages-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of baggage information for specific airline flights. By accessing the baggage data associated with flights, users can efficiently track and manage passenger luggage details. Typical consumers of this API include airline staff and travel applications that aim to provide real-time baggage status updates to travelers. This resource is essential for enhancing the overall travel experience and improving operational efficiencies in luggage handling.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed baggage information related to specific flights. It provides insights into baggage allowances, fees, and regulations, helping travelers prepare for their journeys.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve baggage information for flights. It requires specific details to ensure accurate results related to the traveler’s baggage query.
